get_emas_tuple_order.meaning: OraclePack.getEMAs() returns the tuple ordered spotEMA(0), fastEMA(1), slowEMA(2), eonsEMA(3), medianTick(4)

twap_tick_used_for_liquidation.meaning: the twapTick value consumed by PanopticPool.getTWAP() and fed as sqrtRatioAtTick(twapTick) into getLiquidationBonus for liquidation bonus and conversion pricing
twap_tick_used_for_liquidation.checkpoint: after twapEMA() computes twapTick, at liquidation pricing consumption

intended_twap_tick.meaning: the intended TWAP tick 0.6*fast + 0.3*slow + 0.1*eons consistent with the system's own interpretation of getEMAs()
intended_twap_tick.checkpoint: derived from getEMAs() tuple per intended weighting

fast_ema.meaning: fastEMA component (index 1) of the getEMAs() tuple

slow_ema.meaning: slowEMA component (index 2) of the getEMAs() tuple

eons_ema.meaning: eonsEMA component (index 3) of the getEMAs() tuple

assumptions: The intended TWAP weighting 0.6*fast + 0.3*slow + 0.1*eons is the system's own interpretation of the getEMAs() tuple ordering.
Liquidation bonus and conversion pricing are derived from sqrtRatioAtTick(twapTick) as stated in the impact.

unresolved.description: The report does not supply numeric EMA values or a concrete scenario showing the wrong TWAP reaching a live dispatch call; the equality of the consumed twapTick to the intended TWAP is formalized symbolically.

limitations: Only the liquidation-pricing impact is formalized; stale-guard and solvency impacts are handled in separate passes.
The intended TWAP is expressed as the scaled sum 6*fast + 3*slow + eons (tenths of a tick) to avoid division; the consumed twapTick is compared against this scaled quantity.
